events.title: Elvis Birthday Bash with Mike Albert & Scot Bruce
events.description: Tickets: $39 Mike Albert and Scot Bruce are widely considered the premier Elvis impersonators of our time, performing as the older and younger Elvis, respectively. Mike Albert’s Elvis tribute show has become known worldwide for the respectful portrayal of the late Elvis Presley. Mike has won several major world Elvis contests, and demand for his shows resulted in putting together a seven piece Big “E” Band to emulate the sound Elvis’ band had in the Vegas shows and on tour. Years ago, a part-time “gig” blossomed into a full-time career for Scot Bruce. Because of his uncanny resemblance to the young “King,” along with his ability to sing and strum a guitar, Scot’s live show has taken him all over the world. Scot has had the honor of performing with the legendary Jordanaires, Elvis’ original backup singers. Come experience AMT’s Elvis Birthday Bash and see why audiences are … All Shook Up! events.title: Dominate the Storm: A Heart Pumping Evening with Reed Timmer, America’s Most Famous Storm Chaser
events.description: Tickets: $25 $30 $35 $45 Never Stop Chasing! Experience the raw power of nature through the eyes of Dr. Reed Timmer, extreme meteorologist, scientist, and one of the world’s most renowned storm chasers. With a PhD in meteorology from the University of Oklahoma, Reed has devoted his life to intercepting the planet’s most dangerous storms, collecting groundbreaking scientific data, and helping audiences better understand how severe weather is changing. Over the past several decades, Reed has intercepted more than 1,000 tornadoes and 50 hurricanes, including EF5 tornadoes and Category 5 hurricanes. He is also the inventor of the Dominators—armored, tank-like storm-chasing vehicles equipped with advanced meteorological sensors, hydraulic anchoring spikes, drones, probes, balloons, and even model rockets. Since 2020, Reed has driven Dominator 3 directly into 10 tornadoes, more than any other person in history. His unforgettable expeditions include recording 140 mph winds from inside a Nebraska tornado and launching a trackable sensor into a mile-wide EF4 tornado in Kansas. Carried as high as 39,000 feet and reaching speeds of 190 mph, the sensor captured unprecedented data throughout its 30-mile journey inside the vortex. Currently chasing storms for the National Geographic Channel and RadarOmega, Reed also provides vital real-time reports through traditional and social media. Hear the incredible stories, witness breathtaking footage, and discover the science behind Earth’s most powerful storms during this heart-pumping live event. For Reed Timmer, “Never Stop Chasing” is more than a motto—it is a way of life. For certain concerts, audience members may prefer to stand or dance, especially when encouraged by the artist to do so. events.title: Temple Grandin
events.description: Tickets: $24 $29 $39 $44 Dr. Temple Grandin is a world-renowned animal scientist, bestselling author, autism advocate, and one of TIME magazine’s 100 Most Influential People. A professor of animal science at Colorado State University, she revolutionized humane livestock handling and designed systems used throughout the United States and Canada. Diagnosed with severe autism as a child, Dr. Grandin overcame significant challenges to become an influential scientist, educator, and inspirational speaker. Through acclaimed books such as Thinking in Pictures, Animals in Translation, and The Autistic Brain, she has helped millions better understand autism, animal behavior, and the power of thinking differently. Hear the remarkable story, insights, and experiences of a trailblazer whose work continues to transform animal welfare and inspire more inclusive ways of seeing the world. events.title: KC & The Sunshine Band: Get Down Tonight World Tour 2027
events.description: Tickets: $79 $89 $109 $129 Get ready to dance the night away as KC and The Sunshine Band bring the Get Down Tonight 2027 World Tour to American Music Theatre! Led by Harry Wayne “KC” Casey, the legendary group has spent more than five decades creating the kind of feel-good music that gets audiences out of their seats and onto the dance floor. Formed in 1973, KC and The Sunshine Band helped define the unmistakable “Miami sound,” blending Caribbean influences, R&B, and funk into an infectious style that became a worldwide phenomenon. With more than 100 million records sold worldwide, their extraordinary catalog includes unforgettable hits such as “Get Down Tonight,” “That’s the Way (I Like It),” “Boogie Shoes,” “(Shake, Shake, Shake) Shake Your Booty,” “I’m Your Boogie Man,” and “Please Don’t Go.” The group became the first act since The Beatles to score four No. 1 pop singles within a 12-month period and has earned three GRAMMY Awards, an American Music Award, and a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. Decades after they first filled dance floors around the world, KC and The Sunshine Band continue to bring their signature combination of funk, disco, irresistible grooves, and pure celebration to audiences everywhere. events.title: Little River Band with Seals & Crofts 2
events.description: Tickets: $64 $74 $84 $94 The Eagles’ founding member, the late Glenn Frey, knew what he was saying when he dubbed Little River Band “the best singing band in the world.” The current lineup of LRB takes that accolade to heart every time they perform. Experience the timeless harmonies and heartfelt storytelling of Seals & Crofts 2 — a tribute and continuation of the iconic musical legacy of the 1970s soft rock duo, Seals & Crofts. Featuring Brady Seals (cousin of Jim Seals and former member of Little Texas) and Lua Crofts (daughter of Dash Crofts), this dynamic duo brings a fresh and soulful interpretation of the original hits that defined a generation. With voices that echo their legendary family ties and a chemistry that captivates audiences of all ages, Seals & Crofts 2 perform beloved classics like “Summer Breeze,” “Diamond Girl,” and “We May Never Pass This Way (Again),” alongside new original music that honors the spirit and sincerity of the originals. events.description: Tickets: $39 $44 $49 $59 Experience an evening of exceptional musicianship and timeless American music with Ricky Skaggs & Kentucky Thunder at American Music Theatre! events.description: Tickets: $39 $49 $59 The High Kings bring their acclaimed Power of the People Tour 2027 to American Music Theatre, celebrating the songs, stories, and unmistakable spirit of Irish music. Over more than 15 years, the group has grown into one of the most internationally successful contemporary Irish folk acts of its generation, earning a worldwide following with soaring harmonies, masterful musicianship, powerful storytelling, and an electrifying live show. Their latest album, The Road Not Taken, became their most commercially successful release to date, reaching No. 1 on Ireland’s Independent Album and Folk Album charts and No. 2 on the U.S. Singer-Songwriter Album chart, while surpassing 14 million streams. The band’s momentum continues to build around the world. The High Kings now attract more than 2 million monthly Spotify listeners, have generated millions of weekly streams, and performed before approximately 30,000 people at Notre Dame Stadium in 2024. Their music has also reached new audiences through major collaborations and screen appearances, including the soundtrack to Ryan Coogler’s Sinners, Disney+’s Only Murders in the Building, and a collaboration with legendary Journey frontman Steve Perry on “The Streets of Kinsale.” Their recent single “The Irish Roar” has become one of the band’s biggest digital successes, generating millions of streams and views worldwide. Now, following the biggest world tour of their career, The High Kings return to America with a concert built for massive singalongs and unforgettable shared moments. Audiences can expect beloved Irish favorites, songs from across the band’s eight-album catalog, newer music, breathtaking harmonies, and the unmistakable energy that has made their live performances so celebrated around the globe.
